title: Excellent MacBook Air M2 (13.6-inch) performance
text: The MacBook Air M2 (13.6-inch) handles coding, multitasking, and daily productivity tasks smoothly. Battery endurance and display clarity are standout features.

title: Good value, but has thermal and noise trade-offs
text: I enjoy using the MacBook Air M2 (13.6-inch), but under sustained high workloads fan noise increases and keyboard deck gets warm.

title: Port selection and upgrade limitations
text: The MacBook Air M2 (13.6-inch) is fine for basic tasks, but limited port options or soldered RAM make future upgrades frustrating.

title: Great daily phone, but battery/charging has minor drawbacks
text: The Samsung Galaxy S24 5G screen is crisp, but battery drain on 5G cellular data is noticeable during heavy navigation and gaming.

text: Initial setup of Samsung Galaxy S24 5G includes unwanted apps. Low-light photos also lose fine texture details in night shots.

title: Superb sound clarity and noise isolation on Sony WH-1000XM5
text: The active noise cancellation and sound signature on the Sony WH-1000XM5 isolate ambient ambient chatter during work or travel.

title: Good audio, ear cushion pressure takes time to adjust
text: The audio quality of Sony WH-1000XM5 is clear, but ear cups feel snug during long listening sessions beyond 2 hours.

title: Companion app glitches and plastic feel
text: While sound output is decent on Sony WH-1000XM5, the companion app sometimes drops Bluetooth pairing and body feels basic.
